title: Dynamic Mirror-MoE without discrete expert routing
hypothesis: One input-conditioned Givens-view FFN can approximate four-output soft-MoE while using fewer stored bytes and active FFN compute, and can improve on a parameter-near FiLM control.
physical_object: one shared 16->12->10 FFN plus a three-angle code generator
mirror_coordinate: m(x) is three input-generated Givens angles rotating hidden preactivation coordinates in the shared FFN
logical_multiplicity: one input-specific logical FFN per example, executed once
controls: standard soft-MoE with four full experts and input gate
single shared FFN with input-conditioned FiLM scale/bias
teacher: softmax gate over four FFNs; experts share a random common initialization with independent fixed Gaussian perturbations of scale 0.15; gate is input-dependent

development.selection_metric: held-out MSE normalized by target variance, evaluated on both fixed dev worlds

fresh.run_only_if: development quality, byte and compute gates all pass

paid_objects: all expert/shared FFN weights and biases

compute.proxy: MAC proxy for router/code/FiLM generation, Givens application, and active FFN evaluations; soft-MoE counts four FFNs

success_gate: In each fresh world, Mirror normalized MSE <=1.25x soft-MoE and <=1.15x FiLM, payload <=0.60x soft-MoE, compute <=0.50x soft-MoE.
failure_gate: Any development quality/bytes/compute gate misses; fresh remains sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic teacher and fixed-update screen only.
Soft-MoE evaluates all four experts; compute proxy includes all four forward paths.
